attempts.summary: Deployed a Python stdlib inventory web app (JSON API on /, /inventory, /healthz) on node2 and node3, each running as a systemd service (inventory-app.service) on port 8080, with firewalld opened for 8080. Installed and configured nginx on node1 as an HTTP load balancer (upstream round-robin) listening on port 80, forwarding to node2:8080 and node3:8080, with the stock default nginx server block disabled to avoid a port-80 conflict, SELinux httpd_can_network_connect enabled to permit proxying, and firewalld opened for the http service. Verified round-robin distribution across both backends. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, active services, HTTP 200) on all three nodes, sequentially rebooted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polled each until reachable again, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed inventory-app.service (node2/node3) and nginx (node1) were active again with the load balancer correctly alternating between both healthy backends after every restart.
